description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for different methods, including TrajICL, Head Tuning, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minFDE20, also with a linear scale, ranging from 0.8 to 1.3, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The TrajICL line is blue, solid, and marked with circles, starting at approximately 0.91 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.85 at a ratio of 1.0. The Head Tuning line is orange, solid, and marked with circles, beginning at about 1.32 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to approximately 1.05 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line is red, solid, and marked with circles, starting at around 1.21 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to about 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line is purple, solid, and marked with circles, beginning at approximately 1.21 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0. The plot shows a general downward trend for all lines as the ratio increases.
